eol_note: true because the operating system of this platform, Windows 2000, is out of vendor support (Firefox 10 is out of support too, but the backend rule is about the operating system). How the Web page knows: a browser cannot read the system version, but its user agent states 'Windows NT <major>.<minor>' truthfully up to NT 6.3 (Windows 8.1); the page (ui/legacy/web/app.js, systemVersion) hands the family Windows and that version to loomora_is_eol when the major is below 10, and the family Web with version 0.0 (never end of life) otherwise, because Windows 10 and 11 both say NT 10.0 and macOS, Linux and Android give no usable version. The thresholds and the warning text stay in the backend; the C API is unchanged (six exports). Consequence: a Web page on Windows 10 or 11, or on any non-Windows system, never shows the notice, whatever the age of the browser. History: the first series of 2026-11-15 recorded eol false and eol_warning_shown false (the page then always asked for family Web, version 0.0).
floor_note: Floor of the Web Legacy JavaScript path for the PoC (owner decision 2026-11-15: Internet Explorer up to 9 is dropped because it has no typed arrays, the path is validated on ONE lowest testable browser, a Firefox compatible with Windows 2000, and success there stands for newer browsers). Firefox 10.0 is the browser the owner installed in the Windows 2000 VM (Firefox 10 is the last release that installs on Windows 2000: later ones need Windows XP). Older Firefox (4 to 9 have typed arrays) and other browsers were not run.
eol_source: validation/sources.json eol-windows-10: the page reads 'Windows NT 5.0' in the user agent of Firefox 10 and hands the family Windows and version 5.0 to the backend (loomora_is_eol), whose rule (core/src/eol.cpp) treats every Windows below NT 11.0 as end of life; the notice (loomora_eol_warning) was shown and eol_warning_shown is true in all 15 records of the second series of 2026-11-15. Microsoft ended support for Windows 2000 in July 2010 and Mozilla stopped Firefox 10 in 2012 (author's knowledge, not re-read).
